# googleplay_tracks (Data Source)

The tracks of an app, built-in and custom, with the releases currently on each.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "googleplay_tracks" "app" {
  package_name = "com.example.app"
}

output "track_names" {
  value = data.googleplay_tracks.app.names
}

# The version codes currently on the production track.
output "production_version_codes" {
  value = flatten([
    for track in data.googleplay_tracks.app.tracks :
    [for release in track.releases : release.version_codes]
    if track.track == "production"
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `package_name` (String) The package name (application id) of the app, for example `com.example.app`. The app must already exist in Play Console: the API cannot create one.

### Read-Only

- `names` (Set of String) The identifiers of every track of the app.
- `tracks` (Attributes List) Every track of the app, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tracks))

<a id="nestedatt--tracks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tracks`

Read-Only:

- `releases` (Attributes List) The active releases on the track. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tracks--releases))
- `track` (String) The identifier of the track.

<a id="nestedatt--tracks--releases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tracks.releases`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The name of the release.
- `status` (String) The status of the release: `draft`, `inProgress`, `halted` or `completed`.
- `user_fraction` (Number) The fraction of users a staged release is served to. Null unless the release is staged.
- `version_codes` (List of String) The version codes of the release, as strings.
